title: Validator: Number input requirement validator (daisyUI)
notes:
Validator class changes the color of form elements to error or success based on input's validation rules.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/validator/+page.md
code: Must be between be 1 to 10
